R10.roundtrip_msg: [Layer 3 Semantic BASELESS]: The original legal clause (Article 13(2)) specifically governs the creditor's right to terminate the consumer's right to draw down on an open-end credit agreement for objectively justified reasons, along with the obligation to inform the consumer of this termination and the reasons. The constraint addresses the initial credit decision phase (rejection vs. disbursement), whereas the legal clause addresses the post-contractual management of open-end credit facilities. Therefore, the constraint is not a legitimate operationalization of the specific legal text provided. (Back-translation: Activities 'A_Denied' and 'A_Pending' cannot both occur in the same credit case.)
